reply.text:
I can't give you a number on that one. How much caffeine is too much depends on you, your health and any medication you take, so a doctor or dietitian is the right person for the amount.

What I can say is that three before a session is a lot of stimulant stacked in a short window. Energy drinks vary widely in what's in them, so check the label. How you sleep, how your training feels and how you handle the day are all worth watching.

If you want to cut back, I can help on the training side, like warm-ups and sleep timing, so you're not leaning on them to get going.
